issues.title: Race Condition in Multi-Language Envelope Validation
issues.why: The Go/PHP/Python reference implementations for ErrorEnvelope (Phase 57) use simple regex for timestamps/codes but do not address thread-safety for the shared registry or concurrent log writes mentioned in INV-05.
issues.fix: Add a 'Concurrency' section to Phase 57 requiring mutex-protected registry lookups in Go and atomic log appends.

issues.title: Ambiguous Retry Policy Units
issues.why: The JSON Schema for ErrorEvent defines 'backoff_ms' as an integer but doesn't specify if it's a constant, linear, or exponential base.
issues.fix: Update the schema description for backoff_ms to specify 'constant delay in milliseconds'.

issues.title: Missing Failure Example for Merge
issues.why: The 'Error merge methods' section in the changelog (v2.2.0) describes merging multiple AppErrors but lacks a worked JSON example of a merged response envelope.
issues.fix: Add a sample JSON block showing a 'Results' array containing multiple merged error objects.
